Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Communications Executive position at Cigna Healthcare. With a background in digital marketing, content development, and campaign activation, I am excited about the opportunity to support the International Organisations Health brand strategy and thought leadership platform.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content creation, and WordPress site management. I have also developed and executed integrated campaigns across digital channels, monitoring performance and optimizing for impact. My experience with cross-functional stakeholders and external agencies has taught me to navigate complex environments and deliver high-quality materials on time.

I am particularly drawn to Cigna's mission to improve health and well-being, and I am eager to contribute to meaningful work that supports IGOs, NGOs, and governments. My adaptability, strong writing skills, and project management abilities align well with the requirements of this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Communications Executive position at Cigna Healthcare. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, content creation, and campaign activation, I am eager to contribute to the International Organisations Health (IOH) brand strategy and thought leadership initiatives.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed and executed on-page SEO strategies, created keyword-targeted content, and managed WordPress sites for clients. This experience has sharpened my ability to translate strategic priorities into practical campaign plans and messaging. I have also collaborated with cross-functional teams and external partners to deliver high-quality materials across various touchpoints, including web, email, and social media.

One of my proudest achievements is my project mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD), and ran iterative SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project demonstrates my ability to take ownership, adapt to changing priorities, and deliver measurable results.

I am particularly drawn to Cigna's mission to improve health, well-being, and peace of mind. The opportunity to support IGOs, NGOs, and governments in providing quality healthcare resonates with my values. My strong writing skills, attention to detail, and project management abilities make me well-suited to support the development of compelling campaigns and thought leadership content.

I am confident in my ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and to contribute to the success of the IOH team. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills and experiences align with Cigna's goals.

Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
